result.summary: Implemented docs/agents/design/REQ-030.md exactly as designed -- walk-in registration at the door via /walkin ||, with the confirm/cancel/override state carried in the BOT'S OWN MESSAGE TEXT (re-parsed on each tap), never in callback_data, memory, or a DB column. No schema change (design Sec0, independently re-confirmed: users.tgId nullable+unique, profiles' relaxed NOT NULLs, uq_registrations_event_user, chk_registrations_checked_in_only_if_admitted all pre-exist from REQ-010/011/019-schema/020/028/029). 1. apps/bot/src/domain/walkin.ts (NEW): parseWalkinArgs/validateWalkinFields (Sec2, isNonBlank reused unchanged from profile.ts), normalizePhoneForMatching (Sec3.2, digit-strip only), decideWalkinOutcome (Sec5's exact 7-row first-match-wins table), formatWalkinConfirmMessage/formatWalkinOverrideMessage/parseWalkinMessageFields (Sec7.1's canonical Event:/Name:/Company:/Phone: line format and its exact re-parse rule, degrading to { ok: false } on any missing prefix line -- never a crash), and commitWalkin (Sec6.2's exact 10-step transactional sequence: lock the events row FOR UPDATE, resolve-or-create the person via a phone match run inside the SAME transaction, lock any existing registration row, compute seatsLeft fresh, decide, and write admission/checked_in_at/checked_in_by/check_in_method/qr_token together with exactly one writeAuditLog call keyed by outcome -- registration.checkin for an existing-admitted check-in, registration.walkin_admit when seatsLeft>0, registration.walkin_override_admit when overrideConfirmed resolved an at-capacity add). 2. apps/bot/src/domain/user.ts: added getUserIdByPhone(db, normalizedPhone) (Sec3.4 -- one SELECT joining users->profiles, phone matched via a declarative SQL-side regexp_replace digit-strip, never an application-level comparison) and createWalkinUser(db, {chapterId, consentPdAt}) (Sec6.3 -- the ONLY point in this flow that writes a new User row, tg_id/tg_username left NULL, consent_pd_at set on the SAME INSERT statement per S1). 3. apps/bot/src/domain/profile.ts: added createWalkinProfile(db, {userId, name, company, phone}) (Sec6.4 -- one INSERT setting only first_name/company/phone, every other column left at its default/NULL, the whole door-collected name stored as-is into first_name with last_name left NULL per Open Question 5). 4. apps/bot/src/handlers/walkin.ts (NEW): makeWalkinCommandHandler (Sec8.1 -- parses, resolves the event, authorizes via requireOrganizerForChapter [REQ-016, reused unchanged -- NEVER requireEventStaffForEvent, AC6's core choice], validates fields, then replies with the canonical confirm message + Confirm/Cancel buttons and performs NO write of any kind, which is what makes AC1 structurally true); makeWalkinConfirmCallbackHandler and makeWalkinOverrideCallbackHandler (Sec8.2/8.3 -- both re-derive the event, RE-AUTHORIZE via requireOrganizerForChapter a second/third time, re-parse the tapped message's own ctx.callbackQuery.message.text via parseWalkinMessageFields, refusing with a stale-message alert on any parse failure, then call commitWalkin with overrideConfirmed false/true respectively and route the outcome to the matching reply); makeWalkinCancelCallbackHandler (Sec8.4 -- shared by the initial Cancel and the override step's Dismiss button, no db parameter, never reads or writes anything). 5. apps/bot/src/i18n/{types.ts,en.ts,ru.ts}: added the walkin top-level catalog key (Sec9) -- usage, eventNotFound, notAuthorized, missingName, missingPhone, consentStatement, staleMessage, eventNotReady/Cancelled/Finished, alreadyCheckedIn, success (interpolated with {name}/{company}, never phone), overridePrompt (interpolated with {admittedCount}/{capacity}), cancelled, and the four button labels. Placeholder/minimal functional copy per decisions/0002 (CONTENT-BA owns final wording). 6. apps/bot/src/index.ts: registered bot.command("walkin", ...) plus the three new callback patterns (WALKIN_CONFIRM_PATTERN, WALKIN_OVERRIDE_PATTERN, the literal "walkin:cancel" string), placed alongside the other organizer-authorized, id-parameterized commands, after the generic message:text/message:contact listeners were already registered (grammY's command matcher takes precedence regardless of registration order for /-prefixed text, matching this file's own existing ordering discipline). All 6 ACs verified with real output against a live scratch Postgres (apps/bot/docker-compose.yml, port 55432, already running/migrated). New test file apps/bot/src/handlers/walkin.db.test.ts, 6 describe blocks (one per AC, AC3 split into two: confirm-the-override and dismiss-the-override), real bot.handleUpdate() dispatch throughout (/walkin command updates + walkin:confirm/walkin:override/walkin:cancel callback_query updates whose message.text is populated with the PRIOR reply's own captured text, exercising the real re-parse mechanism the design's Sec1.1 depends on, not a shortcut). AC1 (zero-row-abandon) evidence: users/profiles/registrations row counts captured via a raw `SELECT count(*)` before running /walkin and again after the command reply (Confirm button rendered, never tapped) -- all three counts byte-identical (test: 'REQ-030 AC1'). AC5 (no-phone-leak) evidence: grepped apps/bot/src/domain/walkin.ts, apps/bot/src/handlers/walkin.ts, apps/bot/src/domain/user.ts, apps/bot/src/domain/profile.ts for any log.*/console.* call site -- ZERO exist in any of the four files, so the raw phone value structurally never reaches a log line; additionally the AC5 test asserts the seeded phone string '+998912345678' appears in neither the JSON-stringified audit_log payload nor as a payload object key, across every audit row written by the flow. Commands run from the REPO ROOT: `npm run lint` -> exit 0 (apps/bot 0 problems; apps/web 2 pre-existing unrelated -element warnings, untouched by this diff). `npm run build` -> exit 0 (apps/web Next.js build + apps/bot tsc, both clean). `npx vitest run --no-file-parallelism` (repo root, no path filter) -> 30 files / 300 tests passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped (up from the pre-existing 28 files / 286 tests before this branch's changes -- +1 new test file [walkin.db.test.ts], +7 new tests, zero regressions elsewhere). `git status --porcelain` confirms exactly the 6 modified files plus the 3 new files listed in artifacts_out -- no stray file, apps/web and messages/** untouched.

commands: npm run lint (repo root) -> exit 0, apps/bot 0 problems, apps/web 2 pre-existing unrelated warnings only
npm run build (repo root) -> exit 0, apps/web Next.js build clean, apps/bot tsc clean
npx vitest run --no-file-parallelism apps/bot/src/handlers/walkin.db.test.ts (repo root) -> 1 file / 7 tests passed
npx vitest run --no-file-parallelism (repo root, full suite) -> 30 files / 300 tests passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped (was 28 files / 286 tests before this branch)

git grep -n "log\.\|console\." apps/bot/src/domain/walkin.ts apps/bot/src/handlers/walkin.ts apps/bot/src/domain/user.ts apps/bot/src/domain/profile.ts -> zero matches (AC5 structural proof: no log call site in any of the four files ever receives the phone value)
git status --porcelain -> exactly 6 modified files (profile.ts, user.ts, en.ts, ru.ts, types.ts, index.ts) + 3 new files (walkin.ts x2, walkin.db.test.ts), matching artifacts_out

ac_results.AC1: PASS -- running /walkin then never tapping Confirm: users/profiles/registrations row counts captured before and after are byte-identical (test 'REQ-030 AC1')
ac_results.AC2: PASS -- confirming with seats remaining (capacity 10) sets admission='admitted', checked_in_at non-null, check_in_method='manual', all in one commitWalkin call/transaction; success reply shows name+company
ac_results.AC3: PASS (2 tests) -- at capacity (1/1), the confirm tap surfaces the override offer (no registration row yet, user/profile already resolved per Open Question 3); confirming the override admits+checks in with exactly 1 'registration.walkin_override_admit' audit row; a separate test confirms dismissing the override offer via walkin:cancel creates zero registration rows for that person
ac_results.AC4: PASS -- a second walk-in with the same phone number differently formatted ('+998 90 111-22-33' vs '+998901112233') resolves to the SAME user/profile row (byte-identical users/profiles counts before and after), the existing profile's name/company are left untouched, and two registrations (one per event) exist for that one user
ac_results.AC5: PASS -- zero log.*/console.* call sites in any of the four new/touched domain+handler files; the audit_log payload for a successful walk-in admit is asserted to contain neither the raw phone string nor a 'phone' key
ac_results.AC6: PASS -- a plain user (not organizer, not assigned as EventStaff either) invoking /walkin is refused with catalog.walkin.notAuthorized, zero new users/profiles/registrations rows
